## Scope check

Droply is a one-time, two-device, peer-to-peer transfer tool. Please note how this fits:

- [ ] Does not require storing file contents on a server
- [ ] Does not add accounts, tracking or a transfer history
- [ ] Can work without paid infrastructure (or the paid part is optional and documented)
